issue.title: gcal: calendar-mark legend in the Events sync stamp, after stamp parsers accept trailing segments
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Proposed by bob-cli-lr.5 (note #3), the enable-birthdays phase of epic bob-cli-lr
(plan:202611/gcal_calendar_marks.md). Filed by the bob-cli-lr land agent.

Rows from non-primary calendars now start their title with that calendar's mark (for
example `- **all day** 🎂 Ava's Birthday [📅](…)`). The note never says which calendar a
mark stands for. Add a legend to the Events sync stamp, such as
`_↻ synced … · [account](…) · 🎂 Birthdays_`, so the note explains its own marks.

This needs the stamp parsers to accept trailing segments first: bob-cli's stamp parser,
Ledger Tools in bob-plugins, and Bob Mac Capture all read the stamp line. Change those
parsers before the writer, across all three repos.

## Why out of scope

bob-cli-lr listed "a stamp legend" as a v1 non-goal because today's stamp parsers reject
extra segments, and changing them is a cross-repo parse-contract change.

## Evidence

- Plan § Non-goals (v1): "A stamp legend, mark-derived colours, and per-calendar ack or
  row-mode policy."
- `docs/gcal.md` § Events documents the current stamp shape.

task_type_fields.proposal: Append a mark legend (for example 🎂 Birthdays) to the Events sync stamp once bob-cli, Ledger Tools, and Bob Mac Capture stamp parsers accept trailing segments.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-lr made the stamp legend a v1 non-goal because it is a cross-repo stamp parse-contract change.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-lr.5 proposed it as a planned follow-up; marked rows never say which calendar a mark means inside the note.
